topics.title: Trees

topics.title: Graphs

topics.title: Sorting

topics.notes: Divide & conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking, two-pointer, sliding window.

topics.title: String algorithms
topics.notes: KMP, regex, tokenization, parsing.

topics.title: Memory

topics.title: Assembly basics

topics.title: Operating systems

topics.title: Concurrency

topics.title: Compilers basics
topics.notes: Lexing → parsing → semantic analysis → optimization → codegen. Just enough to understand what my code compiles to.

topics.title: Systems programming

topics.title: Query optimization

topics.title: Replication & partitioning
